_module: view/terrain/finish3d.ts, view/board3d.ts (buildFinish): the finish lines of the official sheet (Thunder_Road_Finishlines.pdf). Presentation only: which one a game shows changes no rule. Lengths in road spaces (1 = the width of a space) unless said otherwise.
_length: how far the piece runs past the rear edge of the even rows it locks into (the sheet: 52.2 mm on a 42.9 mm space, less the teeth's play)
_terrain: the ground of each row on the piece, as the sheet paints it: the road goes on in the two middle rows

cliff._: at: where the ground breaks off; jag: how far the edge wanders; depth: how deep the canyon is; width: how wide, past the piece; run: how far past the piece it goes on at each end before it closes; rim: size of the rocks on its far side

wall._: at: where the wall's face stands; height; target: radius of the outer ring of the painted target, as a share of the height

grid._: at: the first of the laser lattices; gap: between one lattice and the next; planes: how many; height; cell: size of a mesh of the lattice; beam: thickness of a beam

dome._: at: where the dome meets the ground; radius: of its curve, leaning back over the road; height: how high it is drawn before it fades; opacity: at its foot; wings: how far it goes on past the road's rows at each side, turning back
